sequence_points.name: Battle Scene with Cavalry
sequence_points.description: A dramatic historical painting depicting a group of mounted soldiers in combat, rendered in dark, earthy tones with dynamic movement and intense action. The figures are dressed in period military attire, suggesting a 17th or 18th-century battle scene.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with Bare Trees and Building
sequence_points.description: A muted landscape painting depicting bare trees in the foreground with a building visible in the background, rendered in earthy tones. The composition suggests a winter or early spring scene, mounted on a museum wall.

sequence_points.name: Floral Still Life with Vase
sequence_points.description: A still life painting featuring a bouquet of white and light-colored flowers arranged in a vase, set against a dark background. The composition emphasizes the delicate petals and natural forms, rendered in soft, impressionistic brushwork.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with Snow-Capped Mountains and River
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting snow-capped mountains in the background, a calm river or lake in the midground, and a flat, earth-toned foreground. The artwork is mounted on a wall and appears to be framed.
